description: An EOW of a type this node does not recognise, in a D_PDU addressed to it, is answered with an UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR EOW in the next D_PDU sent to that node; one in a D_PDU to a group is not answered.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). groups is [0.0.2.1]. At 1500, during the burst, conn 1 sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation): no SIS output. At 2000, two single-segment type 7 D_PDUs from 0.0.1.3, EOT 10 (end 7000), reception window 0, DATA S_PDU SAP 9 to SAP 7 (no client, so not delivered, A-0235): C_PDU ID 1 to 0.0.1.2, individual, address size 4, EOW 0x7AB (type 7, RESERVED, contents 0xAB); C_PDU ID 2 to group 0.0.2.1, address size 7, EOW 0xE12 (type 14, RESERVED). Both EOW types are unrecognised (C-0405, C-0412, C-0421). The first is answered: UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR, EOW 0x307 (type 3, reserved bits 0, unrecognised type 7; C-0446 to C-0448), owed to 0.0.1.3; the second, to a group, is not (C-1079), or it would have replaced it with 0x30E. Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 rule 1 holds (the group D_PDU is non-ARQ to a group, K-0068), CONT_WAIT 45000; at 52000 the type 7 for "hello" (C_PDU ID 0, TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms) goes out carrying EOW 0x307 instead of EMPTY (C-0396, C-1079), EOT and reception window 10.
